context:
Evaluating a Coralogix support response for this user question:

We modified spanmetrics exclude_dimensions and are considering exclude_dimensions: ["collector.instance.id"]. We run several collector agents for the same service_name. Is it safe to remove collector.instance.id if the other labels stay the same?

checklist.name: collector-instance-id
checklist.description: The response matches the pattern: collector[._]instance[._]id

checklist.name: writer-unique-single
checklist.description: The response matches the pattern: (?i)(writer[- ]unique|single[- ]writer|multiple writers|stable writer)

checklist.name: explains-that-collector-instance-id-is-a-conn
checklist.description: Explains that collector.instance.id is a connector-generated default dimension used to keep spanmetrics single-writer in multi-collector or multi-agent deployments, and should not be excluded unless another stable writer-unique dimension is already in place. FAIL if it says exclude_dimensions: ["collector.instance.id"] is safe without another unique writer dimension.
